author: Jordan Boyer
description: Comparison of different TypeScript validation libraries
name: validation-lib-comparaison

scripts.bench:bun: hyperfine 'bun src/arktype.ts' 'bun src/suretype.ts' 'bun src/valibot.ts' 'bun src/zod-mini.ts' 'bun src/zod3.ts' 'bun src/zod4.ts'
scripts.bench:node: hyperfine --runs 10 'node dist/arktype.js' 'node dist/valibot.js' 'node dist/zod-mini.js' 'node dist/zod3.js' 'node dist/zod4.js'
scripts.bench:node:strip: hyperfine --runs 10 'node --experimental-strip-types src/arktype.ts' 'node --experimental-strip-types src/valibot.ts' 'node --experimental-strip-types src/zod-mini.ts' 'node --experimental-strip-types src/zod3.ts' 'node --experimental-strip-types src/zod4.ts'
scripts.build: turbo run build:app && echo build completed successfully
scripts.build:app: bun scripts/build.ts && echo build:app completed successfully
scripts.check: turbo run --output-logs=errors-only lint:install build:app lint:types lint:knip lint:format lint:issues lint:repo test:unit && echo check completed successfully
scripts.check:once: bun src/arktype.ts && bun src/suretype.ts && bun src/valibot.ts && bun src/zod-mini.ts && bun src/zod3.ts && bun src/zod4.ts && echo check:once success
scripts.lint: turbo run lint:install lint:types lint:knip lint:format lint:issues lint:repo && echo lint completed successfully
scripts.lint:format: oxfmt --check && echo lint:format completed successfully || (echo Please run pnpm run lint:format:fix to format the code && exit 1)
scripts.lint:install: pnpm install && echo lint:install completed successfully
scripts.lint:issues: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives && echo lint:issues completed successfully || (echo Please run pnpm run lint:issues:fix to fix the lint issues && exit 1)
scripts.lint:types: tsc -p tsconfig.json && echo lint:types completed successfully
scripts.test: turbo run test:unit && echo test completed successfully
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --coverage && echo test:unit completed successfully
scripts.test:update: vitest run --update && echo test:update completed successfully
scripts.up:deps: pnpm update --recursive --latest && echo up:deps completed successfully
